payload.text: devbin ships NO assertion that can go stale. init proposes only from the RFC-derived rules and the structural pair invariant -- neither of which rots on a vendor's schedule -- and every vendor-derived field goes to unreviewed:, populated from the live estate. Reworded from 'check must report the standard's age on every run' by hv's ruling of 2026-09-08: that wording presumed a shipped vendor table, and the recovered one proposed NOTHING at N=1 (two rows estate-inferred and self-barred, one an absence, one a prohibition), so there is no age to report. The requirement is met by construction rather than by machinery -- nothing shipped can go stale, so no staleness can hide.
